name: Osananajimi no Kanojo ga, Giri no Ani to Futari de Kurashi Hajimeta Ken ni Tsuite
original_name: 幼馴染の彼女が、義理の兄と2人で暮らし始めた件について
source:
Eri was a bright and popular girl with style and friends.
This story is about her.

Eri's neighbor was a boy two years older named Shogo.
They were good friends and over time became lovers.

One day Eri's parent got remarried, and she gained a new brother, Masao.
Masao was atrocious and cruel, making her his slave. Unlike sex with Shogo,
she felt no passion at all with him. But over time his force broke her...
and then she learned that she loved being mistreated.
In the end, her heart and body are surrendered fully to cruel Masao.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ087147.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
埃里是一个聪明、受欢迎的女孩，有风格，有朋友。
这个故事是关于她的。

惠理的邻居是一个大两岁的男孩，名叫翔吾。
他们是好朋友，随着时间的推移成为了恋人。

有一天，惠理的父母再婚，她有了一个新兄弟，正夫。
正男残暴残忍，让她成为他的奴隶。与与Shogo发生性关系不同，
她对他毫无热情。但随着时间的推移，他的力量让她崩溃了……
然后她发现她喜欢被虐待。
最终，她的心和身体完全臣服于残酷的正雄。
